assign.title: Servex: queued spawns not dropped as landed; follower acks don't wake the parent
assign.brief: Owner (voice) via session-smart-v-sq8y7db: spawn queue dropped ai-system-mastermind; followers wake the smart seat on every followed line.

log.msg: Queue: drop reason was 'its task ai-system-mastermind has landed' (Servex.stale -> Agents.blocked landed check matched an OLD task by id), not a RAM timeout; none exists. Fix: landed counts only against spec.task.dir; a drop messages the parent.

Follow: delivery is agents.send (message queue). Nobody instructs a reply; Agents.wake_parent sends every child turn's last words to its parent with a reply-to header. Fix: a turn started only by followed lines that ends with a short ack wakes nobody. Docs: Servex/doc/follow.md, dormant.md. Test: node Servex/Gate-stale.test.mjs.
